after: Stem I (Preterit unbelegt/Infectum: məfṭaxər (belegt; Stammbestimmung vorläufig)): 1: (intrans.) stolz sein, Grund zum Stolz haben

new_senses.gloss: (intrans.) stolz sein, Grund zum Stolz haben
new_senses.rationale: Generic ḥa in a lazəm d- clause is the pride-holder; the fruit-tree comparison supplies the grounds for pride despite adverse treatment. One attestation. I is provisional by the glossary convention for comparable m-prefixed loans tkbr and štbhr, not a reconstructed paradigm.

added_examples.turoyo: W hawxa. Mmašela ʕam i ʕito di səryoyuṯo, d kətyo be səʕud, d latla šanṣ w iqbal. Faqaṭ me ǧəha ste lazəm d ḥa d məfṭaxər, čənki u ilono d obe fire ḥalye, dayəma kməmḥe kefe ebe, kmətwori ač čuqliyatayḏe (šuġlayḏe, ǦB) mi xaṣraṯe w maṯe.
added_examples.translation: And so it has gone with the Syriac church, which is unfortunate, which has no luck or good fortune. But on one side one must also take pride, because the tree that gives sweet fruit is always struck with stones; its little branches (its branches, Jan B.) are broken from this side and that.
added_examples.rationale: Only occurrence for a genuinely absent root; explicit modal pride predicate and its grounds. No unattested Preterit or government is supplied. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation.
